data.disagreement_analysis: The 'inconclusive' verdict from qwen3-235b was caused by an API failure (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) during the full review phase, not by any actual security concerns in the code. The other models correctly identified the package as safe.
coverage_issues: qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 experienced an API failure (HTTP 400) during the full PKGBUILD review, resulting in a missing verdict for that file.
learnings: API errors and tool crashes should be explicitly categorized as coverage issues rather than contributing to an 'inconclusive' security verdict.
Implement retry logic or fallback models for transient API errors to avoid unnecessary audit escalations.
